title: Inline Cache (IC) State Machine Simulator
subtopicTitle: V8 Internals: Hidden Classes & Inline Caches
concept: Monomorphic, Polymorphic, and Megamorphic IC Transitions
problemStatement: Implement `createInlineCache(maxPolymorphic = 4)` that tracks property lookups across observed object shapes. Return an object with `access(shapeId)` and `getCacheState()` returning 'UNINITIALIZED', 'MONOMORPHIC', 'POLYMORPHIC', or 'MEGAMORPHIC'.
interviewTrap: Once an inline cache transitions to Megamorphic, V8 abandons inline machine code stub lookups and falls back to a global hash table lookup, permanently losing optimization for that call site.

testCases.name: Single shape stays Monomorphic
testCases.testFn: const ic = createInlineCache(4); ic.access('ShapeA'); ic.access('ShapeA'); return ic.getCacheState();

testCases.name: Multiple shapes up to limit transition to Polymorphic
testCases.testFn: const ic = createInlineCache(4); ic.access('A'); ic.access('B'); ic.access('C'); return ic.getCacheState();

testCases.name: Exceeding threshold triggers Megamorphic fallback
testCases.testFn: const ic = createInlineCache(4); ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E'].forEach(s => ic.access(s)); return ic.getCacheState();

details.name: Multiple shapes up to limit transition to Polymorphic

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: V8 assigns a Hidden Class (Map) to every object. Adding properties in different orders or using 'delete' splits the transition tree and degrades inline caches from Monomorphic (fastest) to Megamorphic (hash table lookup fallback).
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Initialize execution context and environment records for Monomorphic, Polymorphic, and Megamorphic IC Transitions.
2. Execute logic adhering to ECMAScript standard specification.
3. Verify invariant boundaries and edge conditions.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals: In JavaScript engines (e.g. V8), Monomorphic, Polymorphic, and Megamorphic IC Transitions is optimized via inline caches, heap contexts, and bytecode translation.
edgeCasesHandled: Once an inline cache transitions to Megamorphic, V8 abandons inline machine code stub lookups and falls back to a global hash table lookup, permanently losing optimization for that call site.

verifiedRules: Adheres to ECMAScript runtime evaluation specifications.
